# stat_kappa {#sec-doc}
    

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}    


```julia
stat_kappa(data, lam, dist_null, chart_choice)
```
Compute the sequence of EWMA-smoothed κ chart statistics for the discrete-valued time series `data`; see [`chart_stat_qual`](@ref).
 
  * `data::Vector{<:Real}`: discrete-valued time series.
  * `lam::Float64`: smoothing parameter of the EWMA statistic.
  * `dist_null`: in-control (null) distribution; its support and probabilities initialize the recursion.
  * `chart_choice`: one of [`KappaN1`](@ref)`()`, [`KappaN2`](@ref)`()`, [`KappaO1`](@ref)`()`, [`KappaO2`](@ref)`()`.
Returns a vector with one chart statistic per time step.
 


:::
